CREATE VIEW dw_btl_ace_oz_build.edw_t_d_ax_dim_outward_policy_section_identifier_1 (
  Outward_Policy_Section_Identifier,
  Outward_Section_Source_Key,
  Outward_Section_Natural_Key,
  Master_Policy_Section_Key,
  Master_Section_Natural_Key,
  Master_Section_Underwriting_Reference,
  Master_Section_Source_Key,
  SII_Transaction_Type_ID,
  SII_Transaction_Type_Name,
  SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code,
  SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Description,
  SII_Line_Of_Business_Key,
  Is_SII_Non_Life_Annuity_Flag,
  SII_Non_Life_Annuity_Code,
  EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Key,
  EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code,
  EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Class_Description,
  Reinsured_From_Outward_Section_Identifier,
  Reinsured_From_Outward_Section_Natural_Key,
  Reinsured_From_Outward_Section_Source_Key,
  Reinsured_To_Outward_Section_Identifier,
  Reinsured_To_Outward_Section_Natural_Key,
  Reinsured_To_Outward_Section_Source_Key)
WITH SCHEMA COMPENSATION
AS WITH CTE_stage_src AS (
    SELECT distinct
        
        stage.Outward_Section_Natural_Key,
        stage.Master_Policy_Section_Natural_Key,
        stage.Master_Section_Underwriting,
        stage.Outward_Section_Source_Natural_Key,
        stage.SII_Transaction_Type_ID,
        stage.SII_Transaction_Type_Name,
        stage.SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code,
        stage.SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Description,
        stage.Is_SII_Non_Life_Annuity_Flag,
        stage.SII_Non_Life_Annuity_Code,
        stage.EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code,
        stage.EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Class_Description,

        
        UPPER(TRIM(stage.Outward_Section_Natural_Key)) AS nk_outward_section,
        UPPER(TRIM(stage.Master_Policy_Section_Natural_Key)) AS nk_master_policy_section,
        UPPER(TRIM(stage.Outward_Section_Source_Natural_Key)) AS nk_outward_section_source_code,

        
        CONCAT(
            stage.SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code,
            '~',
            SUBSTR(
                stage.SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code,
                INSTR(stage.SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code, '_') + 1
            ),
            '~',
            stage.SII_Transaction_Type_ID,
            '~',
            stage.SII_Non_Life_Annuity_Code
        ) AS sii_lob_natural_key_raw,
        UPPER(TRIM(CONCAT(
            stage.SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code,
            '~',
            SUBSTR(
                stage.SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code,
                INSTR(stage.SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code, '_') + 1
            ),
            '~',
            stage.SII_Transaction_Type_ID,
            '~',
            stage.SII_Non_Life_Annuity_Code
        ))) AS nk_sii_lob_natural_key_raw,
        CONCAT(
            stage.EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code,
            '~',
            SUBSTR(
                stage.EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code,
                INSTR(stage.EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code, '_') + 1
            ),
            '~',
            stage.SII_Transaction_Type_ID,
            '~',
            stage.SII_Non_Life_Annuity_Code
        ) AS eiopa_lob_natural_key_raw,
        UPPER(TRIM(CONCAT(
            stage.EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code,
            '~',
            SUBSTR(
                stage.EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code,
                INSTR(stage.EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code, '_') + 1
            ),
            '~',
            stage.SII_Transaction_Type_ID,
            '~',
            stage.SII_Non_Life_Annuity_Code
        ))) AS nk_eiopa_lob_natural_key_raw
    FROM axiom_btl_ppd_spl.dw_btl_edw_stage_build.stage_dim_outward_policy_section AS stage
),

CTE_dim_source_lkp AS (
    SELECT
        UPPER(TRIM(Source_Code)) AS nk_outward_section_source_code,
        Source_Key
    FROM axiom_btl_ppd_spl.dw_btl_ace_oz_build.dim_source 
),

CTE_code_conversion_sii AS (
    SELECT
        
        UPPER(TRIM(Map_From_Code)) AS nk_map_from_code,
        DWH_Code AS sii_dwh_code
    FROM axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_dwh_edw_static_code_conversion
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(Source_System_Identifier)) = 'TFRM'
      AND UPPER(TRIM(Code_Type)) = '28'
),

CTE_code_conversion_eiopa AS (
    SELECT
        
        UPPER(TRIM(Map_From_Code)) AS nk_map_from_code,
        DWH_Code AS eiopa_dwh_code
    FROM axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_dwh_edw_static_code_conversion
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(Source_System_Identifier)) = 'TFRM'
      AND UPPER(TRIM(Code_Type)) = '32'
),

CTE_dim_sii_lob_lkp AS (
    SELECT
        UPPER(TRIM(SII_Line_Of_Business_Natural_Key)) AS nk_sii_lob,
        SII_Line_Of_Business_Key
    FROM axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_dwh_edw_static_dim_sii_line_of_business 
),

CTE_dim_eiopa_lob_lkp AS (
    SELECT
        UPPER(TRIM(EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Natural_Key)) AS nk_eiopa_lob,
        EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Key
    FROM axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_dwh_edw_static_dim_eiopa_line_of_business
),

CTE_existing_dim AS (
    SELECT
        
        UPPER(TRIM(CAST(Outward_Section_Source_Key AS STRING))) AS nk_outward_section_source_key,
        UPPER(TRIM(Outward_Section_Natural_Key)) AS nk_outward_section,
        Outward_Policy_Section_Identifier
    FROM axiom_btl_ppd_spl.dw_btl_ace_oz_build.dim_outward_policy_section_identifier_dummy 
),

CTE_candidate_rows AS (
    SELECT
        dim_source.Source_Key AS Outward_Section_Source_Key,
        
        UPPER(TRIM(CAST(dim_source.Source_Key AS STRING))) AS nk_outward_section_source_key,
        src.nk_outward_section,
        src.Outward_Section_Natural_Key,
        dim_source.Source_Key AS Master_Section_Source_Key,
        master_dim.Outward_Policy_Section_Identifier AS Master_Policy_Section_Key,
        src.Master_Policy_Section_Natural_Key AS Master_Section_Natural_Key,
        src.Master_Section_Underwriting AS Master_Section_Underwriting_Reference,
        src.SII_Transaction_Type_ID,
        src.SII_Transaction_Type_Name,
        src.SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code,
        src.SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Description,
        COALESCE(sii_lob.SII_Line_Of_Business_Key, 0) AS SII_Line_Of_Business_Key,
        src.Is_SII_Non_Life_Annuity_Flag,
        src.SII_Non_Life_Annuity_Code,
        COALESCE(eiopa_lob.EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Key, 0) AS EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Key,
        src.EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code,
        src.EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Class_Description
    FROM CTE_stage_src AS src
    LEFT JOIN CTE_dim_source_lkp AS dim_source
        ON src.nk_outward_section_source_code = dim_source.nk_outward_section_source_code
    LEFT JOIN CTE_code_conversion_sii AS sii_cc
        
        ON src.nk_sii_lob_natural_key_raw = sii_cc.nk_map_from_code
    LEFT JOIN CTE_dim_sii_lob_lkp AS sii_lob
        ON UPPER(TRIM(CONCAT(src.sii_lob_natural_key_raw, '~', sii_cc.sii_dwh_code))) = sii_lob.nk_sii_lob
    LEFT JOIN CTE_code_conversion_eiopa AS eiopa_cc
       
        ON src.nk_eiopa_lob_natural_key_raw = eiopa_cc.nk_map_from_code
    LEFT JOIN CTE_dim_eiopa_lob_lkp AS eiopa_lob
        ON UPPER(TRIM(CONCAT(src.eiopa_lob_natural_key_raw, '~', eiopa_cc.eiopa_dwh_code))) = eiopa_lob.nk_eiopa_lob
    LEFT JOIN CTE_existing_dim AS master_dim
        ON UPPER(TRIM(CAST(dim_source.Source_Key AS STRING))) = master_dim.nk_outward_section_source_key
       AND src.nk_master_policy_section = master_dim.nk_outward_section
),

CTE_new_rows AS (
    SELECT candidate.Outward_Section_Source_Key,
        candidate.nk_outward_section_source_key,
        candidate.nk_outward_section,
        candidate.Outward_Section_Natural_Key,
        candidate.Master_Section_Source_Key,
        candidate.Master_Policy_Section_Key,
        candidate.Master_Section_Natural_Key,
        candidate.Master_Section_Underwriting_Reference,
        candidate.SII_Transaction_Type_ID,
        candidate.SII_Transaction_Type_Name,
        candidate.SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code,
        candidate.SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Description,
        candidate.SII_Line_Of_Business_Key,
        candidate.Is_SII_Non_Life_Annuity_Flag,
        candidate.SII_Non_Life_Annuity_Code,
        candidate.EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Key,
        candidate.EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code,
        candidate.EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Class_Description
    FROM CTE_candidate_rows AS candidate
    LEFT ANTI JOIN CTE_existing_dim AS existing_row
        ON candidate.nk_outward_section_source_key = existing_row.nk_outward_section_source_key
       AND candidate.nk_outward_section = existing_row.nk_outward_section
)

SELECT 
    CAST(NULL AS INT) AS Outward_Policy_Section_Identifier,
    COALESCE(new_rows.Outward_Section_Source_Key, 0) AS Outward_Section_Source_Key,
    COALESCE(new_rows.Outward_Section_Natural_Key, '') AS Outward_Section_Natural_Key,
    COALESCE(new_rows.Master_Policy_Section_Key, 0) AS Master_Policy_Section_Key,
    COALESCE(new_rows.Master_Section_Natural_Key, '') AS Master_Section_Natural_Key,
    COALESCE(new_rows.Master_Section_Underwriting_Reference, '') AS Master_Section_Underwriting_Reference,
    COALESCE(new_rows.Master_Section_Source_Key, 0) AS Master_Section_Source_Key,
    COALESCE(new_rows.SII_Transaction_Type_ID, '') AS SII_Transaction_Type_ID,
    COALESCE(new_rows.SII_Transaction_Type_Name, '') AS SII_Transaction_Type_Name,
    COALESCE(new_rows.SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code, '') AS SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code,
    COALESCE(new_rows.SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Description, '') AS SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Description,
    COALESCE(new_rows.SII_Line_Of_Business_Key, 0) AS SII_Line_Of_Business_Key,
    COALESCE(new_rows.Is_SII_Non_Life_Annuity_Flag, '') AS Is_SII_Non_Life_Annuity_Flag,
    COALESCE(new_rows.SII_Non_Life_Annuity_Code, '') AS SII_Non_Life_Annuity_Code,
    COALESCE(new_rows.EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Key, 0) AS EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Key,
    COALESCE(new_rows.EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code, '') AS EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code,
    COALESCE(new_rows.EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Class_Description, '') AS EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Class_Description,
    CAST(NULL AS INT) AS Reinsured_From_Outward_Section_Identifier,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS Reinsured_From_Outward_Section_Natural_Key,
    CAST(NULL AS INT) AS Reinsured_From_Outward_Section_Source_Key,
    CAST(NULL AS INT) AS Reinsured_To_Outward_Section_Identifier,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS Reinsured_To_Outward_Section_Natural_Key,
    CAST(NULL AS INT) AS Reinsured_To_Outward_Section_Source_Key
FROM CTE_new_rows AS new_rows

),

CTE_LKP_Dim_Source_by_Natural_Key AS (
    SELECT
        sq.Master_Policy_Section_Natural_Key,
        sq.SII_Transaction_Type_ID,
        sq.SII_Transaction_Type_Name,

        sq.Is_SII_Non_Life_Annuity_Flag,
        sq.EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code,
        sq.Reinsured_From_Outward_Policy_Section_Natural_Key,
        sq.Reinsured_To_Outward_Policy_Section_Natural_Key,
        sq.Outward_Section_Source_Natural_Key,
        Dim_Source.Source_Key
    FROM CTE_SQ_Stage_Dim_Outward_Policy_Section sq

        ON UPPER(TRIM(Dim_Source.Source_Code)) = UPPER(TRIM(sq.Outward_Section_Source_Natural_Key))
),

CTE_SII_LoB_Key AS (
    SELECT
        sq.Outward_Section_Natural_Key,
        CONCAT(
            sq.SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code, '~',
            SUBSTRING(sq.SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code, LOCATE('_', sq.SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code) + 1),
            '~', sq.SII_Transaction_Type_ID, '~', sq.SII_Non_Life_Annuity_Code
        ) AS v_SII_Line_Of_Business_Natural_Key,
        cc.DWH_Code AS sii_dwh_code,

        AND UPPER(TRIM(cc.Map_From_Code)) = UPPER(TRIM(
            CONCAT(
                sq.SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code, '~',
                SUBSTRING(sq.SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code, LOCATE('_', sq.SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code) + 1),
                '~', sq.SII_Transaction_Type_ID, '~', sq.SII_Non_Life_Annuity_Code

            CONCAT(
                sq.SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code, '~',
                SUBSTRING(sq.SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code, LOCATE('_', sq.SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code) + 1),
                '~', sq.SII_Transaction_Type_ID, '~', sq.SII_Non_Life_Annuity_Code,
                '~', COALESCE(cc.DWH_Code, '')
            )
        ))
),

                '~', sq.SII_Transaction_Type_ID, '~', sq.SII_Non_Life_Annuity_Code
            )
        ))
    LEFT JOIN axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_dwh_edw_static_dim_eiopa_line_of_business AS eiopa_lob
        ON UPPER(TRIM(eiopa_lob.EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Natural_Key)) = UPPER(TRIM(
            CONCAT(
                sq.EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code, '~',
                SUBSTRING(sq.EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code, LOCATE('_', sq.EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code) + 1),
                '~', sq.SII_Transaction_Type_ID, '~', sq.SII_Non_Life_Annuity_Code,
                '~', COALESCE(cc2.DWH_Code, '')
            )
        ))
),

CTE_LKP_OPSI_Main AS (
    SELECT
        src.Master_Policy_Section_Natural_Key,
        src.SII_Transaction_Type_ID,
        src.SII_Transaction_Type_Name,
        src.EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Class_Description,

        lkp_main.SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code AS lkp_main_SII_Line_Of_Business_Class_Short_Code,
        lkp_main.SII_Transaction_Type_Name AS lkp_main_SII_Transaction_Type_Name,
        lkp_main.SII_Transaction_Type_ID AS lkp_main_SII_Transaction_Type_ID,
        lkp_main.EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Key AS lkp_main_EIOPA_Line_Of_Business_Key,
        lkp_main.Reinsured_To_Outward_Section_Source_Key AS lkp_main_Reinsured_To_Outward_Section_Source_Key,

WITH SCHEMA COMPENSATION

    ),

CTE_USM_Raw AS (
    SELECT
        dsy.dsySID    AS Platform_SID,
        dcu.dcuCcyISO AS Sett_Ccy,
        dya.dyaSID    AS YoA,
        CASE
            WHEN dya.dyaSID <= YEAR(current_date()) - 3
                THEN  ( select CAST(YEAR(current_date()) - 2 AS INT) AS Reset_Year ) 
            ELSE dya.dyaSID
        END       AS Reporting_YoA,
        CASE
            WHEN upper(trim(doo.dooOfficeCode)) IN ('SING','AUS','HK','LAB','SHN') THEN 'Asia'
            WHEN upper(trim(doo.dooOfficeCode)) IN ('BER') THEN 'Bermuda'
            WHEN upper(trim(doo.dooOfficeCode)) IN ('CAL','TOR','CVR','CML') THEN 'Canada'
            WHEN upper(trim(doo.dooOfficeCode)) IN ('ANT','BAR','BOG','CBE','GEN','GER',
                                       'CIN','PAR','CZU','CSP','ROM','OSL') THEN 'Europe'
            WHEN upper(trim(doo.dooOfficeCode)) IN ('LON','RLN','WEL','XXX') THEN 'London'
            ELSE doo.dooOfficeCode
        END       AS IOI_Hub,
        drc.drcRiskCode                                         AS Risk_Code,
        drs.drsCurrentRiskCode                                  AS Default_Risk_Code,
        gcc.gccCostCntrGrpCode                                  AS CCG,
        -- Original Currency derivation
        CASE
            WHEN fus.fusOrigCcyCode = '' AND fus.fusOrigCcyROE = 1
                THEN dcu.dcuCcyISO
            ELSE fus.fusOrigCcyCode
        END       AS fusOrigCcy,
        -- Grouped Original Currency
        RTRIM(
            CASE
                WHEN RTRIM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN fus.fusOrigCcyCode = '' AND fus.fusOrigCcyROE = 1
                            THEN dcu.dcuCcyISO
                        ELSE fus.fusOrigCcyCode
                    END

                    WHEN fus.fusOrigCcyCode = '' AND fus.fusOrigCcyROE = 1
                        THEN dcu.dcuCcyISO
                    ELSE fus.fusOrigCcyCode
                END
            END

        fus.fusOrigCcyROE                                       AS fusOrigROE,
        -- Premium and Claim aggregations
        SUM(
            fus.fusNetAmt
            * CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(fus.fusCatgryCode, 1, 1) IN ('1','2','3') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
            * COALESCE(dui.duiPcnt, 100) / 100

                CASE
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) AS INT) IS NULL
                         AND T.FIL_Code_1 <> '' AND T.FIL_Code_1 IS NOT NULL
                        THEN 'zzOutside Man Range of Fil4 1-4 CHAR'
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL
                         AND RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) = '1'
                        THEN 'Direct (DI)'
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL
                         AND RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) = '2'
                         AND T.audit_dti_code NOT IN ('0','9')
                        THEN 'Facultative Reinsurance (FR)'
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL
                         AND RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) = '3'
                         AND T.audit_dti_code NOT IN ('0','9')
                        THEN 'Non Proportional Treaty (NT)'
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL
                         AND RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) = '4'
                         AND T.audit_dti_code NOT IN ('0','9')
                        THEN 'Proportional Treaty (PT)'
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL
                         AND RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) = '2'
                         AND T.audit_dti_code IN ('0','9')
                        THEN 'Inter Syndicate Facultative Reinsurance (IF)'
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL
                         AND RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) = '3'
                         AND T.audit_dti_code IN ('0','9')
                        THEN 'Inter Non Proportional Treaty (IN)'
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL
                         AND RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) = '4'
                         AND T.audit_dti_code IN ('0','9')
                        THEN 'Inter Syndicate Proportional Treaty (IP)'
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL
                         AND (CAST(RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) AS INT) > 4
                              OR CAST(RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) AS INT) < 1)
                        THEN 'zzOutside Range of Fil4 1-4'
                    WHEN T.FIL_Code_1 = '' OR T.FIL_Code_1 IS NULL
                        THEN 'zzNo or Null Fil4 on USM'
                    ELSE 'UNK-USM'
                END
            ELSE
                -- Manual Data
                CASE
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(df4.df4Fil4Code, 1) AS INT) IS NULL
                         AND (df4.df4Fil4Code <> '' OR df4.df4Fil4Code IS NOT NULL)
                        THEN 'zzOutside Man Range of Fil4 1-4 CHAR'
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(df4.df4Fil4Code, 1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL
                         AND RIGHT(df4.df4Fil4Code, 1) = '1'
                        THEN 'Direct (DI)'
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(df4.df4Fil4Code, 1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL
                         AND RIGHT(df4.df4Fil4Code, 1) = '2'
                        THEN 'Facultative Reinsurance (FR)'
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(df4.df4Fil4Code, 1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL
                         AND RIGHT(df4.df4Fil4Code, 1) = '3'
                        THEN 'Non Proportional Treaty (NT)'
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(df4.df4Fil4Code, 1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL
                         AND RIGHT(df4.df4Fil4Code, 1) = '4'
                        THEN 'Proportional Treaty (PT)'
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(df4.df4Fil4Code, 1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL
                         AND (CAST(RIGHT(df4.df4Fil4Code, 1) AS INT) > 4
                              OR CAST(RIGHT(df4.df4Fil4Code, 1) AS INT) < 1)
                        THEN CONCAT('zzOutside Range of Fil4 1-4 Value=', RIGHT(df4.df4Fil4Code, 1))
                    WHEN df4.df4Fil4Code = '' OR df4.df4Fil4Code IS NULL
                        THEN 'zzNo Fil4 on Manual USM'
                    ELSE 'UNK-MAN'
                END
        END AS Transaction_Type,
        CAST('USM' AS STRING) AS Transaction_Type_Source,
        ocex.Exchange_Rate_First_Currency_to_Second_Currency AS Lloyds_USM_Orig_to_Sett_ROE,
        ocex1.Exchange_Rate_First_Currency_to_Second_Currency AS Lloyds_USM_Orig_to_GBP_ROE

    FROM `axiom_btl_ppd_spl`.`dw_btl_ace_oz_build`.`t_ax_doodimorigoffice` doo
    INNER JOIN `axiom_btl_ppd_spl`.`dw_btl_ace_oz_build`.`t_ax_fusfactusm` fus  ON doo.dooSID = fus.fusSIDdoo
    INNER JOIN `axiom_btl_ppd_spl`.`dw_btl_ace_oz_build`.`t_ax_dccdimcostcentre` dcc  ON dcc.dccSID = fus.fusSIDdcc
    INNER JOIN `axiom_btl_ppd_spl`.`dw_btl_ace_oz_build`.`t_ax_gccgrpcostcentre` gcc  ON gcc.gccSIDdcc = dcc.dccSID
    INNER JOIN `axiom_btl_ppd_spl`.`dw_btl_ace_oz_build`.`t_ax_dcudimcurrency` dcu  ON dcu.dcuSID = fus.fusSIDdcu
    INNER JOIN `axiom_btl_ppd_spl`.`dw_btl_ace_oz_build`.`t_ax_dmodimmonth` dmo  ON dmo.dmoSID = fus.fusSIDdmo
    INNER JOIN `axiom_btl_ppd_spl`.`dw_btl_ace_oz_build`.`t_ax_drcdimriskcode` drc  ON drc.drcSID = fus.fusSIDdrc
    INNER JOIN `axiom_btl_ppd_spl`.`dw_btl_ace_oz_build`.`t_ax_dsydimsyndicate` dsy  ON dsy.dsySID = fus.fusSIDdsy
    INNER JOIN `axiom_btl_ppd_spl`.`dw_btl_ace_oz_build`.`t_ax_dyadimyearac` dya  ON dya.dyaSID = fus.fusSIDdya
    INNER JOIN `axiom_btl_ppd_spl`.`dw_btl_ace_oz_build`.`t_ax_drsdimrisksection` drs  ON drs.drsSID = fus.fusInSIDdrs
    LEFT  JOIN `axiom_btl_ppd_spl`.`dw_btl_ace_oz_build`.`t_ax_usm_dus` dus  ON dus.dusSID = fus.fusSIDdus
    LEFT  JOIN CTE_USM_Raw_base dui  ON dui.duiSIDdus = dus.dusSID
    INNER JOIN `axiom_btl_ppd_spl`.`dw_btl_ace_oz_build`.`t_ax_df4dimfil4` df4  ON df4.df4SID = fus.fusSIDdf4
    LEFT  JOIN axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_dwh_ods_usm_transaction  T  ON dus.dusSID = T.USM_Transaction_SID
    -- ROE: Orig to Sett (Lloyds Monthly Rate)
    LEFT OUTER JOIN axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_frame_ods_currency_exchange_rate ocex
        ON  ocex.First_Currency_ISO_Code = RTRIM(
                CASE
                    WHEN fus.fusOrigCcyCode = '' AND fus.fusOrigCcyROE = 1
                        THEN dcu.dcuCcyISO
                    ELSE fus.fusOrigCcyCode
                END
            )
        AND ocex.Second_Currency_ISO_Code = RTRIM(dcu.dcuCcyISO)
        AND upper(trim(ocex.Profile_Short_Code)) = 'LLOYDS'
        AND TO_DATE(CAST((dmo.dmoSID * 100) + 15 AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd')
            BETWEEN ocex.Start_Date AND COALESCE(ocex.End_Date, TO_DATE('3000-01-01'))
    -- ROE: Sett to GBP (Lloyds Monthly Rate)
    LEFT OUTER JOIN axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_frame_ods_currency_exchange_rate    ocex1
        ON  ocex1.First_Currency_ISO_Code  = RTRIM(dcu.dcuCcyISO)
        AND upper(trim(ocex1.Second_Currency_ISO_Code)) = 'GBP'
        AND upper(trim(ocex1.Profile_Short_Code)) = 'LLOYDS'
        AND TO_DATE(CAST((dmo.dmoSID * 100) + 15 AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd')
            BETWEEN ocex1.Start_Date AND COALESCE(ocex1.End_Date, TO_DATE('3000-01-01'))
    WHERE
        dmo.dmoSID BETWEEN 202601 AND  202603
        AND (
            dsy.dsySyndGroupNmbr IN ('3002','3003','179','2020','97')
            OR dsy.dsySID IN (1209, 861, 588, 990, 1157)
        )
        AND LEFT(fus.fusCatgryCode, 1) IN ('1','2','3','4','5')
        AND dui.duiSID NOT IN (-950000000, -950000001)

    GROUP BY
        dsy.dsySID, dcu.dcuCcyISO, dya.dyaSID,
        -- CASE
        --     WHEN dya.dyaSID <= YEAR(current_date()) - 3 THEN ( select CAST(YEAR(current_date()) - 2 AS INT) AS Reset_Year ) 
        --     ELSE dya.dyaSID
        -- END,
        -- doo.dooOfficeCode,
        CASE
            WHEN upper(trim(doo.dooOfficeCode)) IN ('SING','AUS','HK','LAB','SHN') THEN 'Asia'
            WHEN upper(trim(doo.dooOfficeCode)) IN ('BER')                         THEN 'Bermuda'
            WHEN upper(trim(doo.dooOfficeCode)) IN ('CAL','TOR','CVR','CML')       THEN 'Canada'
            WHEN upper(trim(doo.dooOfficeCode)) IN ('ANT','BAR','BOG','CBE','GEN','GER',
                                       'CIN','PAR','CZU','CSP','ROM','OSL') THEN 'Europe'
            WHEN upper(trim(doo.dooOfficeCode)) IN ('LON','RLN','WEL','XXX')       THEN 'London'
            ELSE doo.dooOfficeCode
        END,
        drc.drcRiskCode, drs.drsCurrentRiskCode, gcc.gccCostCntrGrpCode,
        drs.drsDednBkrge,
        CASE
            WHEN fus.fusOrigCcyCode = '' AND fus.fusOrigCcyROE = 1
                THEN dcu.dcuCcyISO
            ELSE fus.fusOrigCcyCode
        END,
        RTRIM(
            CASE
                WHEN RTRIM(CASE WHEN fus.fusOrigCcyCode = '' AND fus.fusOrigCcyROE = 1
                                THEN dcu.dcuCcyISO ELSE fus.fusOrigCcyCode END)
                     NOT IN ('GBP','USD','CAD','EUR','AUD','JPY') THEN 'OTHER'
                ELSE CASE WHEN fus.fusOrigCcyCode = '' AND fus.fusOrigCcyROE = 1
                          THEN dcu.dcuCcyISO ELSE fus.fusOrigCcyCode END
            END
        ),
        fus.fusOrigCcyROE,
        CASE
            WHEN LEFT(fus.fusCatgryCode, 1) IN ('1','2','3') THEN 'PREM'
            WHEN LEFT(fus.fusCatgryCode, 1) IN ('4','5')     THEN 'CLAIM'
            WHEN LEFT(fus.fusCatgryCode, 1) IN ('6','7')     THEN 'RI PREM'
            WHEN LEFT(fus.fusCatgryCode, 1) IN ('8','9')     THEN 'RI CLAIM'
            ELSE ''
        END,
        dus.dusSID, drs.drsSID,
        -- Transaction Type (repeated for GROUP BY)
        CASE
            WHEN dus.dusSID < 900000000 THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1,1) AS INT) IS NULL
                         AND T.FIL_Code_1 <> '' AND T.FIL_Code_1 IS NOT NULL
                        THEN 'zzOutside Man Range of Fil4 1-4 CHAR'
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1,1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL
                         AND RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1,1) = '1' THEN 'Direct (DI)'
                    ELSE 'UNK-USM'
                END
            ELSE 'UNK-MAN'
        END,
        drs.drsDednTotRate,
        ocex.Exchange_Rate_First_Currency_to_Second_Currency,
        ocex1.Exchange_Rate_First_Currency_to_Second_Currency,
        -- T.FIL_Code_1,
        -- T.audit_dti_code,
        -- df4.df4Fil4Code,
        CASE
            WHEN dus.dusSID < 900000000 THEN
                -- Pure USM Data
                CASE
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) AS INT) IS NULL
                         AND T.FIL_Code_1 <> '' AND T.FIL_Code_1 IS NOT NULL
                        THEN 'zzOutside Man Range of Fil4 1-4 CHAR'
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL
                         AND RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) = '1'
                        THEN 'Direct (DI)'
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL
                         AND RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) = '2'
                         AND T.audit_dti_code NOT IN ('0','9')
                        THEN 'Facultative Reinsurance (FR)'
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL
                         AND RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) = '3'
                         AND T.audit_dti_code NOT IN ('0','9')
                        THEN 'Non Proportional Treaty (NT)'
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL
                         AND RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) = '4'
                         AND T.audit_dti_code NOT IN ('0','9')
                        THEN 'Proportional Treaty (PT)'
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL
                         AND RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) = '2'
                         AND T.audit_dti_code IN ('0','9')
                        THEN 'Inter Syndicate Facultative Reinsurance (IF)'
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL
                         AND RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) = '3'
                         AND T.audit_dti_code IN ('0','9')
                        THEN 'Inter Non Proportional Treaty (IN)'
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL
                         AND RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) = '4'
                         AND T.audit_dti_code IN ('0','9')
                        THEN 'Inter Syndicate Proportional Treaty (IP)'
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL
                         AND (CAST(RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) AS INT) > 4
                              OR CAST(RIGHT(T.FIL_Code_1, 1) AS INT) < 1)
                        THEN 'zzOutside Range of Fil4 1-4'
                    WHEN T.FIL_Code_1 = '' OR T.FIL_Code_1 IS NULL
                        THEN 'zzNo or Null Fil4 on USM'
                    ELSE 'UNK-USM'
                END
            ELSE
                -- Manual Data
                CASE
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(df4.df4Fil4Code, 1) AS INT) IS NULL
                         AND (df4.df4Fil4Code <> '' OR df4.df4Fil4Code IS NOT NULL)
                        THEN 'zzOutside Man Range of Fil4 1-4 CHAR'
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(df4.df4Fil4Code, 1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL
                         AND RIGHT(df4.df4Fil4Code, 1) = '1'
                        THEN 'Direct (DI)'
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(df4.df4Fil4Code, 1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL
                         AND RIGHT(df4.df4Fil4Code, 1) = '2'
                        THEN 'Facultative Reinsurance (FR)'
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(df4.df4Fil4Code, 1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL
                         AND RIGHT(df4.df4Fil4Code, 1) = '3'
                        THEN 'Non Proportional Treaty (NT)'
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(df4.df4Fil4Code, 1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL
                         AND RIGHT(df4.df4Fil4Code, 1) = '4'
                        THEN 'Proportional Treaty (PT)'
                    WHEN TRY_CAST(RIGHT(df4.df4Fil4Code, 1) AS INT) IS NOT NULL
                         AND (CAST(RIGHT(df4.df4Fil4Code, 1) AS INT) > 4
                              OR CAST(RIGHT(df4.df4Fil4Code, 1) AS INT) < 1)
                        THEN CONCAT('zzOutside Range of Fil4 1-4 Value=', RIGHT(df4.df4Fil4Code, 1))
                    WHEN df4.df4Fil4Code = '' OR df4.df4Fil4Code IS NULL
                        THEN 'zzNo Fil4 on Manual USM'
                    ELSE 'UNK-MAN'
                END    END
),

CTE_USM_DATA_SOURCE as (
SELECT
    Platform_SID AS Original_Syndicate,
    CASE
        WHEN YoA <= 2008 THEN 0
        ELSE Platform_SID
    END as Platform_SID,
    YoA as Pure_YoA,
    Reporting_YoA,
    IOI_Hub,
    CASE
        WHEN Risk_Code = '' THEN Default_Risk_Code
        ELSE Risk_Code
    END as Risk_Code,
    CCG,
    Total_Dedns,
    RTRIM(fusOrigCcy) as fusOrigCcy,
    Grouped_Orig_Ccy,
    CASE
        WHEN IFNULL(fusOrigROE, 0) <> 0 THEN fusOrigROE
        ELSE Lloyds_USM_Orig_to_Sett_ROE
    END as ROE_on_USM,
    Lloyds_USM_Orig_to_Sett_ROE,
    Lloyds_USM_Orig_to_GBP_ROE,
    ----   Changes for DWS-5274 and DWS-5275 
    --((100 + Total_Dedns)/100) * GrossPrem_Sett * (CASE WHEN Grouped_Orig_Ccy = 'OTHER' THEN Lloyds_USM_Orig_to_GBP_ROE ELSE Lloyds_USM_Orig_to_Sett_ROE END) as GrossPremGross_Orig,
    CASE
        WHEN IFNULL(Total_Dedns, 0) <> 100 THEN GrossPrem_Sett / (1 - (Total_Dedns / 100))
    END * (
        CASE
            WHEN Grouped_Orig_Ccy = 'OTHER' THEN Lloyds_USM_Orig_to_GBP_ROE
            ELSE Lloyds_USM_Orig_to_Sett_ROE
        END
    ) as GrossPremGross_Orig,
    GrossPrem_Sett * (
        CASE
            WHEN Grouped_Orig_Ccy = 'OTHER' THEN Lloyds_USM_Orig_to_GBP_ROE
            ELSE fusOrigROE
        END
    ) as GrossPrem_Orig,
    GrossPrem_Sett * (
        CASE
            WHEN Grouped_Orig_Ccy = 'OTHER' THEN Lloyds_USM_Orig_to_GBP_ROE
            ELSE fusOrigROE
        END
    ) as GrossPrem_excluding_Tax_Orig,
    cast(0 as decimal(20, 4)) as Tax_amount_Orig,
    GrossClaim_Sett * (
        CASE
            WHEN Grouped_Orig_Ccy = 'OTHER' THEN Lloyds_USM_Orig_to_GBP_ROE
            ELSE fusOrigROE
        END
    ) as GrossClaim_Orig,
    cast(0 as decimal(20, 4)) as OS_Claims_Orig,
    Sett_Ccy,
    --((100 + Total_Dedns)/100) * GrossPrem_Sett as GrossPremGross_Sett,
    CASE
        WHEN IFNULL(Total_Dedns, 0) <> 100 THEN GrossPrem_Sett / (1 - (Total_Dedns / 100))
    END as GrossPremGross_Sett,
    ----  End of DWS-5274 and DWS-5275
    GrossPrem_Sett,
    GrossPrem_Sett as GrossPrem_excluding_Tax_Sett,
    cast(0 as decimal(20, 4)) as Tax_Amount_Sett,
    GrossClaim_Sett,
    cast(0 as decimal(20, 4)) as OS_Claims_Sett,
    fusSIDdus,
    fusSIDdrs,
    Transaction_Type,
    Transaction_Type_Source
from
    CTE_USM_RAW
),
-- select * from  CTE_USM_DATA_SOURCE

CTE_Premium_Credit AS (
    SELECT
        rsd.Risk_Section_SID,
        SUM(COALESCE(rsd.Percentage, 0)) AS Percentage
    FROM `axiom_btl_ppd_spl`.`dw_btl_stage_ace_oz_build`.`stage_risk_section_deduction` rsd
    WHERE rsd.Deduction_Type_Classification_SID IN (
        12759, 27038, 31792, 24354, 11853, 11854, 12793
    )
    AND rsd.Risk_Section_SID IN (SELECT DISTINCT fusSIDdrs FROM CTE_USM_DATA_SOURCE)
    GROUP BY rsd.Risk_Section_SID
),

CTE_Brokerage AS (
    SELECT
        rsd.Risk_Section_SID,
        SUM(COALESCE(rsd.Percentage, 0)) AS Percentage
    FROM `axiom_btl_ppd_spl`.`dw_btl_stage_ace_oz_build`.`stage_risk_section_deduction` rsd
    WHERE rsd.Deduction_Type_Classification_SID IN (
        11948, 13283, 45, 4003, 4005, 4009, 4011,
        4019, 4021, 28679, 24361, 24605, 24348
    )
    AND rsd.Risk_Section_SID IN (SELECT DISTINCT fusSIDdrs FROM CTE_USM_DATA_SOURCE)
    GROUP BY rsd.Risk_Section_SID
),

CTE_Deduction_Percentage AS (
    SELECT
        b.Risk_Section_SID,
        COALESCE(b.Percentage, 0)   AS Acquisition_Percentage,
        COALESCE(pc.Percentage, 0)  AS Premium_Credit,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(pc.Percentage, 0) <> 0
                THEN ((b.Percentage / 100) / (1 - pc.Percentage / 100)) * 100
            ELSE COALESCE(b.Percentage, 0)
        END AS Deduction_Percentage
    FROM CTE_Brokerage b
    LEFT JOIN CTE_Premium_Credit pc ON b.Risk_Section_SID = pc.Risk_Section_SID
     AND b.Risk_Section_SID IN (SELECT DISTINCT fusSIDdrs FROM CTE_USM_DATA_SOURCE)
),

CTE_previous_tax_due AS (

        jl.Settlement_Currency_ISO_Code,
        SUM(jl.Settlement_Amount) AS Tax_Amount_Sett,

        AND upper(trim(j.Source_Table)) = 'USSUSMSYND'
        AND upper(trim(jl.Journal_Line_Nature_Code)) = 'TAXDUE'
    GROUP BY
        jl.Risk_Section_SID,
        ocex1.Exchange_Rate_First_Currency_to_Second_Currency,

        CASE WHEN J.Accounting_Period_Code NOT BETWEEN 202601 AND 202603 THEN 'Previous_Month' END

CTE_UPDATE_USM_DATA_SOURCE_2 as (

    Source1.Pure_YoA,

    CASE WHEN Source1.fusSIDdus = 950000000 and ABS(Source1.GrossPrem_excluding_Tax_Sett) > ABS(Tax_Due.Tax_Amount_Sett) THEN Source1.GrossPrem_excluding_Tax_Sett - Tax_Due.Tax_Amount_Sett

    -- where Source1.fusSIDdus = 950000000

    select
        Journal_Line_Nature_code,
        J.risk_section_sid,
        j.Source_table,
        T.USM_Transaction_SID,
        T.Total_Discount,
        SUM(jl.original_amount) as original_amount,
        SUM(jl.settlement_amount) as settlement_amount
    from
        axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_dwh_ods_usm_transaction T
        left join axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_dwh_ods_usm_syndicate USM ON USM.USM_Transaction_SID = T.USM_Transaction_SID
        left join axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_dwh_ods_journal J on J.journal_sid = USM.journal_sid --left join ODS..journal J on J.Source_ID = USM.USM_Syndicate_SID and Source_Table = 'ussUSMSynd' AND USM.Risk_Section_SID = J.Risk_Section_SID
        left join axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_dwh_ods_journal_line jl on j.journal_sid = jl.journal_sid
        AND UPPER(TRIM(JL.Journal_Line_Nature_code)) IN ('TAXDUE')
        AND JL.ODS_JOURNAL_LINE_ALLOCATION_MONTH BETWEEN 202601 and 202603
    GROUP BY
        Journal_Line_Nature_code,
        J.risk_section_sid,
        j.Source_table,
        T.USM_Transaction_SID,
        T.Total_Discount

  ogpName1,
  ogpDscrip1,
  ogpSort1,
  ogpName2,
  ogpDscrip2,
  ogpSort2,
  source)
WITH SCHEMA COMPENSATION
AS WITH CTE_ogm_gccntr_members AS (
    SELECT
        clsclasn.clsSID AS clsSID,
        clsclasn.clsName AS clsName,
        clsclasn.clsShortCode AS clsShortCode,
        ogmobjgroupmbrshp.ogmSID AS ogmSID,
        ogmobjgroupmbrshp.ogmMbrSID AS ogmMbrSID,
        ogpobjgroup.ogpName AS ogpName1,
        ogpobjgroup.ogpDscrip AS ogpDscrip1,
        ogpobjgroup.ogpSID AS ogpSort1,
        ' ' AS ogpName2,
        ' ' AS ogpDscrip2,
        0 AS ogpSort2,
        1 AS source
    FROM axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_ogmobjgroupmbrshp AS ogmobjgroupmbrshp
    INNER JOIN axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_ogpobjgroup AS ogpobjgroup
        ON ogmobjgroupmbrshp.ogmObjGroupSIDogp = ogpobjgroup.ogpSID
    INNER JOIN `axiom_btl_ppd_spl`.`dw_btl_stage_ace_oz_build`.`clsclasn` AS clsclasn
        ON ogpobjgroup.ogpPurpSIDcls = clsclasn.clsSID
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(clsclasn.clsShortCode)) = 'GCCNTR'
   
    UNION ALL
   
    SELECT
        clsclasn.clsSID AS clsSID,
        clsclasn.clsName AS clsName,
        clsclasn.clsShortCode AS clsShortCode,
        0 AS ogmSID,
        0 AS ogmMbrSID,
        ' ' AS ogpName1,
        ' ' AS ogpDscrip1,
        0 AS ogpSort1,
        ' ' AS ogpName2,
        ' ' AS ogpDscrip2,
        0 AS ogpSort2,
        1 AS source
    FROM `axiom_btl_ppd_spl`.`dw_btl_stage_ace_oz_build`.`clsclasn` AS clsclasn
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(clsclasn.clsShortCode)) = 'GCCNTR'
),
 
CTE_ogm_grc_with_super_group AS (
    SELECT
        clsclasn1.clsSID AS clsSID,
        clsclasn2.clsName AS clsName,
        clsclasn2.clsShortCode AS clsShortCode,
        ogmobjgroupmbrshp1.ogmSID AS ogmSID,
        clsclasn1.clsSID AS ogmMbrSID,
        ogpobjgroup1.ogpName AS ogpName1,
        ogpobjgroup1.ogpDscrip AS ogpDscrip1,
        ogpobjgroup1.ogpSID AS ogpSort1,
        COALESCE(ogpobjgroup2.ogpName, ogpobjgroup1.ogpName) AS ogpName2,
        COALESCE(ogpobjgroup2.ogpDscrip, ogpobjgroup1.ogpDscrip) AS ogpDscrip2,
        COALESCE(ogpobjgroup2.ogpSID, ogpobjgroup1.ogpSID) AS ogpSort2,
        1 AS source
    FROM `axiom_btl_ppd_spl`.`dw_btl_stage_ace_oz_build`.`clsclasn` AS clsclasn2
    INNER JOIN axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_ogpobjgroup AS ogpobjgroup1
        ON clsclasn2.clsSID = ogpobjgroup1.ogpPurpSIDcls
    INNER JOIN axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_ogmobjgroupmbrshp AS ogmobjgroupmbrshp1
        ON ogpobjgroup1.ogpSID = ogmobjgroupmbrshp1.ogmObjGroupSIDogp
    INNER JOIN `axiom_btl_ppd_spl`.`dw_btl_stage_ace_oz_build`.`clsclasn` AS clsclasn1

    INNER JOIN axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_ogmobjgroupmbrshp AS ogmobjgroupmbrshp2

        ogmobjgroupmbrshp1.ogmSID AS ogmSID,

        COALESCE(ogpobjgroup2.ogpSID, ogpobjgroup1.ogpSID) AS ogpSort2,
        1 AS source
    FROM `axiom_btl_ppd_spl`.`dw_btl_stage_ace_oz_build`.`clsclasn` AS clsclasn2
    INNER JOIN axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_ogpobjgroup AS ogpobjgroup1
        ON clsclasn2.clsSID = ogpobjgroup1.ogpPurpSIDcls
    INNER JOIN axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_ogmobjgroupmbrshp AS ogmobjgroupmbrshp1
        ON ogpobjgroup1.ogpSID = ogmobjgroupmbrshp1.ogmObjGroupSIDogp
    INNER JOIN `axiom_btl_ppd_spl`.`dw_btl_stage_ace_oz_build`.`clsclasn` AS clsclasn1
        ON ogmobjgroupmbrshp1.ogmMbrSID = clsclasn1.clsSID

        ON ogpobjgroup2.ogpSID = ogmobjgroupmbrshp2.ogmObjGroupSIDogp
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(clsclasn2.clsShortCode)) LIKE 'GRC%'

CTE_NYID AS (

CTE_N2002 AS (

CTE_STAGE_PTY_dis_base AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ptyparty.ptySID AS disSID,
        COALESCE(N2002.N2002cls, 0) AS disSIDdn2,
        ' ' AS disInsrdCode,
        CAST(CASE 
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM(ptyparty.ptyLongName)) = '       '
            THEN REPLACE(ptyparty.ptyShortName, CHAR(44), ' ')
            ELSE COALESCE(REPLACE(ptyparty.ptyLongName, CHAR(44), ' '), REPLACE(ptyparty.ptyShortName, CHAR(44), ' '))
        END AS VARCHAR(100)) AS disInsrdName,
        clsClasn1.clsName AS disInsrdConst,
        clsClasn1.clsDscrip AS disInsrdNature,
        PYA.pyaAddrsContnt AS disInsrdAddress,
        PYA.pyaMajorCode AS disInsrdAddMajCode,
        PYA.pyaMinorCode AS disInsrdAddMinCode,
        PYA.CntryCode AS disInsrdCntryCode,
        PYA.CntryName AS disInsrdCntryName,
        CTE_LORS.CHILD_LORS AS disLORSId,
        CTE_NAIC.pyiIdntfrContnt AS disNAICId,
        CTE_FEIN.pyiIdntfrContnt AS disFEINId,
        CTE_NYID.pyiIdntfrContnt AS disNYIDId,
        '' AS disSecStatus,
        CTE_LORS.PARENT_ptySID AS disParentLORSId,
        1 AS disSource
    FROM axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_rprriskpartyrole AS rprriskpartyrole
    INNER JOIN axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_ptyparty AS ptyparty
        ON rprriskpartyrole.rprPartySIDpty = ptyparty.ptySID
    LEFT OUTER JOIN `axiom_btl_ppd_spl`.`dw_btl_stage_ace_oz_build`.`clsclasn` AS clsClasn1
        ON ptyparty.ptyPartyNatureSIDcls = clsClasn1.clsSID
    LEFT OUTER JOIN CTE_PYA_with_end_date AS PYA
        ON PYA.pyaPartySIDpty = ptyparty.ptySID
    INNER JOIN axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_prtpartyroletype AS prtpartyroletype
        ON rprriskpartyrole.rprPartyRoleTypeSIDprt = prtpartyroletype.prtSID
        AND UPPER(TRIM(prtpartyroletype.prtname)) IN ('INSURED', 'ADDITIONAL INSURED', 'REASSURED', 'ADDITIONAL REASSURED', 'COVERHOLDER')
    LEFT OUTER JOIN CTE_LORS ON ptyparty.ptySID = CTE_LORS.CHILD_ptySID
    LEFT OUTER JOIN CTE_NAIC ON ptyparty.ptySID = CTE_NAIC.ptySID
    LEFT OUTER JOIN CTE_FEIN ON ptyparty.ptySID = CTE_FEIN.ptySID
    LEFT OUTER JOIN CTE_NYID ON ptyparty.ptySID = CTE_NYID.ptySID
    LEFT OUTER JOIN CTE_N2002 AS N2002 ON N2002.pyfOwnerSIDpty = ptyparty.ptySID

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT
        ptyparty.ptySID AS disSID,
        COALESCE(CTE_N2002.N2002cls, 0) AS disSIDdn2,
        ' ' AS disInsrdCode,
        CASE 
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM(ptyparty.ptyLongName)) = '       '
            THEN REPLACE(ptyparty.ptyShortName, CHAR(44), ' ')
            ELSE COALESCE(REPLACE(ptyparty.ptyLongName, CHAR(44), ' '), REPLACE(ptyparty.ptyShortName, CHAR(44), ' '))
        END AS disInsrdName,
        clsClasn1.clsName AS disInsrdConst,
        clsClasn1.clsDscrip AS disInsrdNature,
        CTE_PYA.pyaAddrsContnt AS disInsrdAddress,
        CTE_PYA.pyaMajorCode AS disInsrdAddMajCode,
        CTE_PYA.pyaMinorCode AS disInsrdAddMinCode,
        CTE_PYA.CntryCode AS disInsrdCntryCode,
        CTE_PYA.CntryName AS disInsrdCntryName,
        CTE_LORS.CHILD_LORS AS disLORSId,
        CTE_NAIC.pyiIdntfrContnt AS disNAICId,
        CTE_FEIN.pyiIdntfrContnt AS disFEINId,
        CTE_NYID.pyiIdntfrContnt AS disNYIDId,
        '' AS disSecStatus,
        CTE_LORS.PARENT_ptySID AS disParentLORSId,
        1 AS disSource
    FROM axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_inlinsdline AS inlinsdline
    INNER JOIN axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_ptyparty AS ptyparty
        ON inlinsdline.inlPartySIDpty = ptyparty.ptySID
    LEFT OUTER JOIN `axiom_btl_ppd_spl`.`dw_btl_stage_ace_oz_build`.`clsclasn` AS clsClasn1
        ON ptyparty.ptyPartyNatureSIDcls = clsClasn1.clsSID
    LEFT OUTER JOIN CTE_PYA ON CTE_PYA.pyaPartySIDpty = ptyparty.ptySID
    LEFT OUTER JOIN CTE_LORS ON ptyparty.ptySID = CTE_LORS.CHILD_ptySID
    LEFT OUTER JOIN CTE_NAIC ON ptyparty.ptySID = CTE_NAIC.ptySID
    LEFT OUTER JOIN CTE_FEIN ON ptyparty.ptySID = CTE_FEIN.ptySID
    LEFT OUTER JOIN CTE_NYID ON ptyparty.ptySID = CTE_NYID.ptySID
    LEFT OUTER JOIN CTE_N2002 ON CTE_N2002.pyfOwnerSIDpty = ptyparty.ptySID

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT
        0 AS disSID,
        0 AS disSIDdn2,
        '' AS disInsrdCode,
        '' AS disInsrdName,
        NULL AS disInsrdConst,
        NULL AS disInsrdNature,
        NULL AS disInsrdAddress,
        NULL AS disInsrdAddMajCode,
        NULL AS disInsrdAddMinCode,
        NULL AS disInsrdCntryCode,
        NULL AS disInsrdCntryName,
        NULL AS disLORSId,
        NULL AS disNAICId,
        NULL AS disFEINId,
        NULL AS disNYIDId,
        NULL AS disSecStatus,
        NULL AS disParentLORSId,
        1 AS disSource
),


CTE_security_status AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(impsecuritystatus.LORS_CODE, ''))) AS LORS_CODE,
        impsecuritystatus.BESTS,
        impsecuritystatus.S_and_P,
        impsecuritystatus.BAD_DEBT_PCNT
    FROM axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_dwh_stand_data_impsecuritystatus AS impsecuritystatus


),

CTE_STAGE_PTY_dis_with_ratings AS (
    SELECT
        base.disSID,
        base.disSIDdn2,
        base.disInsrdCode,
        base.disInsrdName,
        base.disInsrdConst,
        base.disInsrdNature,
        base.disInsrdAddress,
        base.disInsrdAddMajCode,
        base.disInsrdAddMinCode,
        base.disInsrdCntryCode,
        base.disInsrdCntryName,
        base.disLORSId,
        base.disNAICId,
        base.disFEINId,
        base.disNYIDId,
        base.disSecStatus,
        base.disParentLORSId,
        base.disSource,
        SD.BESTS AS disRatingBEST,
        SD.S_and_P AS disRatingSandP,
        Cast(NULL AS string) AS disRatingMiller,
        CASE 
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(SD.BESTS, ''))) = 'A++' THEN '1'
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(SD.BESTS, ''))) = 'A+' THEN '2'
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(SD.BESTS, ''))) IN ('A', 'A-') THEN '3'
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(SD.BESTS, ''))) IN ('B++', 'B+') THEN '4'
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(SD.BESTS, ''))) IN ('B', 'B-') THEN '5'
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(SD.BESTS, ''))) IN ('C++', 'C+') THEN '6'
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(SD.BESTS, ''))) IN ('C', 'C-') THEN '7'
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(SD.BESTS, ''))) IN ('D', 'D-', 'E', 'E-', 'F', 'F-', 'S') THEN '8'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS disTier,
        SD.BAD_DEBT_PCNT AS disBadDebtTier
    FROM CTE_STAGE_PTY_dis_base AS base
    LEFT OUTER JOIN CTE_security_status AS SD
        ON UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(SD.LORS_CODE, ''))) = UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(base.disLORSId, '')))
    --WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(base.disLORSId, '')) IS NOT NULL
),

CTE_STAGE_PTY_dis_final AS (
    SELECT
        disSID,
        disSIDdn2,
        disInsrdCode,
        disInsrdName,
        disInsrdConst,
        disInsrdNature,
        disInsrdAddress,
        disInsrdAddMajCode,
        disInsrdAddMinCode,
        disInsrdCntryCode,
        disInsrdCntryName,
        disLORSId,
        disNAICId,
        disFEINId,
        disNYIDId,
        disSecStatus,
        disParentLORSId,
        disSource,
        disRatingBEST,
        disRatingSandP,
        disRatingMiller,
        CASE WHEN disTier IS NULL AND disLORSId IS NOT NULL THEN 'NR' ELSE disTier END AS disTier,
        CASE WHEN disTier IS NULL AND disLORSId IS NOT NULL THEN 25.00 ELSE disBadDebtTier END AS disBadDebtTier
    FROM CTE_STAGE_PTY_dis_with_ratings
),

CTE_RiskLocn AS (
    SELECT
        slasectlocapp.slaRiskSectSIDrks AS InSIDdrs,
        MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(clsclasn.clsName)) = 'COUNTRY' THEN loclocn.locSID ELSE NULL END) AS locCountry,
        MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(clsclasn.clsName)) = 'RISK COUNTRY' THEN loclocn.locSID ELSE NULL END) AS locRiskCountry,
        MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(clsclasn.clsName)) = 'BUSINESS DOMICILED IN' THEN loclocn.locSID ELSE NULL END) AS locPtyAdr
    FROM axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_slasectlocapp AS slasectlocapp
    INNER JOIN `axiom_btl_ppd_spl`.`dw_btl_stage_ace_oz_build`.`clsclasn` AS clsclasn
        ON slasectlocapp.slaSecLocnAplicyTypeSIDcls = clsclasn.clsSID
    INNER JOIN axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_loclocn AS loclocn
        ON slasectlocapp.slaLocnSIDloc = loclocn.locSID
    GROUP BY slasectlocapp.slaRiskSectSIDrks
),

CTE_PTY_ADDRESS AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        AllAddr.frkInsrdSIDdis AS ptySID,
        loclocn.locCode,
        loclocn.locName
    FROM (
        SELECT rl.InSIDdrs, rl.locPtyAdr, frk.frkInsrdSIDdis
        FROM CTE_RiskLocn AS rl
        INNER JOIN `axiom_btl_ppd_spl`.`dw_btl_stage_ace_oz_build`.`stage_risk_frk` AS frk
            ON rl.InSIDdrs = frk.frkSIDdrs
    ) AS AllAddr
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT frk.frkInsrdSIDdis, COUNT(DISTINCT rl.locPtyAdr) AS countloc
        FROM CTE_RiskLocn AS rl
        INNER JOIN `axiom_btl_ppd_spl`.`dw_btl_stage_ace_oz_build`.`stage_risk_frk` AS frk
            ON rl.InSIDdrs = frk.frkSIDdrs
        GROUP BY frk.frkInsrdSIDdis
        HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rl.locPtyAdr) = 1
    ) AS SingleAddr
        ON SingleAddr.frkInsrdSIDdis = AllAddr.frkInsrdSIDdis
    INNER JOIN axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_loclocn AS loclocn
        ON AllAddr.locPtyAdr = loclocn.locSID
),
CTE_STAGE_PTY_dis_with_address AS (
    SELECT
        dis.disSID,
        dis.disSIDdn2,
        dis.disInsrdCode,
        dis.disInsrdName,
        dis.disInsrdConst,
        dis.disInsrdNature,
        dis.disInsrdAddress,
        dis.disInsrdAddMajCode,
        dis.disInsrdAddMinCode,
        COALESCE(addr.locCode, dis.disInsrdCntryCode) AS disInsrdCntryCode,
        COALESCE(addr.locName, dis.disInsrdCntryName) AS disInsrdCntryName,
        dis.disLORSId,
        dis.disNAICId,
        dis.disFEINId,
        dis.disNYIDId,
        dis.disSecStatus,
        dis.disParentLORSId,
        dis.disSource,
        dis.disRatingBEST,
        dis.disRatingSandP,
        dis.disRatingMiller,
        dis.disTier,
        dis.disBadDebtTier
    FROM CTE_STAGE_PTY_dis_final AS dis
    LEFT JOIN CTE_PTY_ADDRESS AS addr
        ON addr.ptySID = dis.disSID
)

SELECT

FROM CTE_STAGE_PTY_dis_with_address

CREATE VIEW dw_btl_stage_ace_oz_build.t_ax_stage_pty_dsy (
  dsySID,
  dsySyndNmbr,
  dsySyndGroupNmbr,
  dsySyndGroupName,
  dsySource)
WITH SCHEMA COMPENSATION
AS WITH CTE_STAGE_PTY_dsy AS (
    SELECT
        CASE 
            WHEN CAST(pyipartyidntfr.pyiIdntfrContnt AS INT) IS NOT NULL
            THEN pyipartyidntfr.pyiIdntfrContnt
            ELSE CAST(ptyparty.ptySID AS STRING)
        END AS dsySID,
        CASE 
            WHEN CAST(ogpobjgroup.ogpName AS INT) IS NULL
            THEN pyipartyidntfr.pyiIdntfrContnt
            ELSE ogpobjgroup.ogpName
        END AS dsySyndNmbr,
        MAX(CASE 
            WHEN CAST(ogpObjGroup1.ogpName AS INT) IS NOT NULL THEN ogpObjGroup1.ogpName
            WHEN CAST(ogpobjgroup.ogpName AS INT) IS NOT NULL THEN ogpobjgroup.ogpName
            ELSE NULL
        END) AS dsySyndGroupNmbr,
        MAX(CASE 
            WHEN ogpObjGroup1.ogpDscrip IS NOT NULL THEN ogpObjGroup1.ogpDscrip
            WHEN CAST(ogpobjgroup.ogpName AS INT) IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ogpobjgroup.ogpName, ptyparty.ptyLongName)
            ELSE NULL
        END) AS dsySyndGroupName,
        1 AS dsySource
    FROM axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_ptyparty AS ptyparty
    INNER JOIN axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_pyipartyidntfr AS pyipartyidntfr
        ON pyipartyidntfr.pyiPartySIDpty = ptyparty.ptySID
    INNER JOIN axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_idsidntfrscheme AS idsidntfrscheme
        ON idsidntfrscheme.idsSID = pyipartyidntfr.pyiIdntfrSchemeSIDids
    LEFT OUTER JOIN axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_ogmobjgroupmbrshp AS ogmobjgroupmbrshp
        ON ogmobjgroupmbrshp.ogmMbrSID = ptyparty.ptySID
        AND UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(ogmobjgroupmbrshp.ogmMbrTable, 'PTYPARTY'))) = 'PTYPARTY'
    LEFT OUTER JOIN axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_ogpobjgroup AS ogpobjgroup
        ON ogmobjgroupmbrshp.ogmObjGroupSIDogp = ogpobjgroup.ogpSID
    LEFT OUTER JOIN `axiom_btl_ppd_spl`.`dw_btl_stage_ace_oz_build`.`clsclasn` AS clsclasn
        ON ogpobjgroup.ogpPurpSIDcls = clsclasn.clssid
        AND UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(clsclasn.clsname, 'SYNDICATE GROUP'))) = 'SYNDICATE GROUP'
    LEFT OUTER JOIN axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_ogmobjgroupmbrshp AS ogmObjGroupMbrshp1
        ON ogmObjGroupMbrshp1.ogmMbrSID = ogpobjgroup.ogpSID
        AND UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(ogmObjGroupMbrshp1.ogmMbrTable, 'OGPOBJGROUP'))) = 'OGPOBJGROUP'
    LEFT JOIN axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_ogpobjgroup AS ogpObjGroup1
        ON ogmObjGroupMbrshp1.ogmObjGroupSIDogp = ogpObjGroup1.ogpSID
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(idsidntfrscheme.idsname)) = 'SYNDICATE NUMBER'
    GROUP BY 
        CASE 
            WHEN CAST(pyipartyidntfr.pyiIdntfrContnt AS INT) IS NOT NULL
            THEN pyipartyidntfr.pyiIdntfrContnt
            ELSE CAST(ptyparty.ptySID AS STRING)
        END,
        CASE 
            WHEN CAST(ogpobjgroup.ogpName AS INT) IS NULL
            THEN pyipartyidntfr.pyiIdntfrContnt
            ELSE ogpobjgroup.ogpName
        END
),

CREATE VIEW dw_btl_stage_ace_oz_build.t_ax_stage_tax_dtb (
  dtbSID,
  dtbTaxBandName,
  dtbTaxBandCode,
  dtbTaxBandDedn,
  dtbSunAccountCode,
  dtbSUNTaxCode,
  dtbTaxRatePcnt,
  dtbTaxFlatAmount,
  dtbTaxFlatCcy,
  dtbAddPcnt,
  dtbTaxType,
  dtbTaxTypeCode,
  dtbJurisdctnCode,
  dtbJurisdctnName,
  dtbJurisdctnDscrip,
  dtbJurisdctnStlmtMthd,
  dtbSource,
  dtbDWHInsDate,
  dtbDWHUpdDate,
  dtbDWHUpProc)
WITH SCHEMA COMPENSATION
AS WITH CTE_tax_band_main AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        txbtaxband.txbSID AS dtbSID,
        txbtaxband.txbName AS dtbTaxBandName,
        txbtaxband.txbShortCode AS dtbTaxBandCode,
        MIN(ded.clsName) AS dtbTaxBandDedn,
        txbtaxband.txbSUNAcctCode AS dtbSunAccountCode,
        txbtaxband.txbSUNTaxCode AS dtbSUNTaxCode,
        MAX(txrtaxrate.txrTaxratePcnt) AS dtbTaxRatePcnt,
        MAX(txrtaxrate.txrFlatAmt) AS dtbTaxFlatAmount,
        ccyccy.ccyISOCode AS dtbTaxFlatCcy,
        MAX(txrtaxrate.txrAdditionPCnt) AS dtbAddPcnt,
        txttaxtype.txtName AS dtbTaxType,
        txttaxtype.txtShortCode AS dtbTaxTypeCode,
        jurjurdct.jurShortCode AS dtbJurisdctnCode,
        jurjurdct.jurName AS dtbJurisdctnName,
        jurjurdct.jurFullDscrip AS dtbJurisdctnDscrip,
        MIN(jsm.clsName) AS dtbJurisdctnStlmtMthd,
        1 AS dtbSource,
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS dtbDWHInsDate,
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS dtbDWHUpdDate,
        'DTB' AS dtbDWHUpProc
    FROM axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_txbtaxband AS txbtaxband
    LEFT JOIN axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_txrtaxrate AS txrtaxrate
        ON txbtaxband.txbSID = txrtaxrate.txrSIDtxb
    LEFT JOIN axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_txttaxtype AS txttaxtype
        ON txttaxtype.txtSID = txbtaxband.txbSIDtxt
    LEFT JOIN axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_jurjurdct AS jurjurdct
        ON jurjurdct.jurSID = txttaxtype.txtSIDjur
    LEFT JOIN axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_jsmjurdctstlmtmethod AS jsmjurdctstlmtmethod
        ON jurjurdct.jurSID = jsmjurdctstlmtmethod.jsmSIDjur
    LEFT JOIN `axiom_btl_ppd_spl`.`dw_btl_stage_ace_oz_build`.`clsclasn` AS jsm
        ON jsm.clsSID = jsmjurdctstlmtmethod.jsmStlmtMethodSIDcls
    LEFT JOIN axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_tbataxbasisadj AS tbataxbasisadj
        ON txttaxtype.txtSID = tbataxbasisadj.tbaSIDtxt
    LEFT JOIN `axiom_btl_ppd_spl`.`dw_btl_stage_ace_oz_build`.`clsclasn` AS ded
        ON ded.clsSID = tbataxbasisadj.tbaDedctnTypeSIDcls
    LEFT JOIN axiom_etl_ppd_lpl.btl_src_tdo.oz_swanreprestore_ccyccy AS ccyccy
        ON txrtaxrate.txrSIDccy = ccyccy.ccySID
    GROUP BY
        txbtaxband.txbSID,
        txbtaxband.txbName,
        txbtaxband.txbShortCode,
        txbtaxband.txbSUNAcctCode,
        txbtaxband.txbSUNTaxCode,
        ccyccy.ccyISOCode,
        txttaxtype.txtName,
        txttaxtype.txtShortCode,
        jurjurdct.jurShortCode,
        jurjurdct.jurName,
        jurjurdct.jurFullDscrip
),

CTE_tax_band_default AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        0 AS dtbSID,
        '' AS dtbTaxBandName,
        CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS dtbTaxBandCode,
        CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS dtbTaxBandDedn,
        CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS dtbSunAccountCode,
        CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS dtbSUNTaxCode,
        CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,6)) AS dtbTaxRatePcnt,
        CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,6)) AS dtbTaxFlatAmount,
        CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS dtbTaxFlatCcy,
        CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,6)) AS dtbAddPcnt,
        CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS dtbTaxType,
        CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS dtbTaxTypeCode,
        CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS dtbJurisdctnCode,
        CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS dtbJurisdctnName,
        CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS dtbJurisdctnDscrip,
        CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS dtbJurisdctnStlmtMthd,
        1 AS dtbSource,
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS dtbDWHInsDate,
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS dtbDWHUpdDate,
        'DTB' AS dtbDWHUpProc
),

CTE_stage_tax_dtb_final AS (
    SELECT
        dtbSID,
        dtbTaxBandName,
        dtbTaxBandCode,
        dtbTaxBandDedn,
        dtbSunAccountCode,
        dtbSUNTaxCode,
        dtbTaxRatePcnt,
        dtbTaxFlatAmount,
        dtbTaxFlatCcy,
        dtbAddPcnt,
        dtbTaxType,
        dtbTaxTypeCode,
        dtbJurisdctnCode,
        dtbJurisdctnName,
        dtbJurisdctnDscrip,
        dtbJurisdctnStlmtMthd,
        dtbSource,
        dtbDWHInsDate,
        dtbDWHUpdDate,
        dtbDWHUpProc
    FROM CTE_tax_band_main
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        dtbSID,
        dtbTaxBandName,
        dtbTaxBandCode,
        dtbTaxBandDedn,
        dtbSunAccountCode,
        dtbSUNTaxCode,
        dtbTaxRatePcnt,
        dtbTaxFlatAmount,
        dtbTaxFlatCcy,
        dtbAddPcnt,
        dtbTaxType,
        dtbTaxTypeCode,
        dtbJurisdctnCode,
        dtbJurisdctnName,
        dtbJurisdctnDscrip,
        dtbJurisdctnStlmtMthd,
        dtbSource,
        dtbDWHInsDate,
        dtbDWHUpdDate,
        dtbDWHUpProc
    FROM CTE_tax_band_default
)

SELECT
    dtbSID,
    dtbTaxBandName,
    dtbTaxBandCode,
    dtbTaxBandDedn,
    dtbSunAccountCode,
    dtbSUNTaxCode,
    dtbTaxRatePcnt,
    dtbTaxFlatAmount,

    dtbAddPcnt,
    dtbTaxType,
    dtbTaxTypeCode,
    dtbJurisdctnCode,
    dtbJurisdctnName,
    dtbJurisdctnDscrip,
    dtbJurisdctnStlmtMthd,
    dtbSource,
    dtbDWHInsDate,
    dtbDWHUpdDate,
    dtbDWHUpProc
FROM CTE_stage_tax_dtb_final
